definitions.explanation: A ball of ground meat mixed with seasonings and other ingredients, then cooked by boiling, frying, or steaming. A common item in home cooking and bento boxes.

examples.japanese: {肉団子|にくだんご}を{作|つく}った。
お{弁当|べんとう}に{肉団子|にくだんご}の{甘酢|あまず}あんを{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I put meatballs in sweet-and-sour sauce in the bento.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}に{肉団子|にくだんご}と{野菜|やさい}を{入|い}れて、{煮込|にこ}みスープを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I put meatballs and vegetables in a pot and made a simmered soup.

notes:
A compound of {肉|にく} (meat) and {団子|だんご} (dumpling, ball). Refers to the Western-style meatball as adapted in Japanese cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉団子|にくだんご}の{甘酢|あまず}あん (meatballs in sweet-and-sour sauce)
- {肉団子|にくだんご}スープ (meatball soup)
- {肉団子|にくだんご}を{丸|まる}める (roll meatballs)

A staple of Japanese home cooking and a popular bento item, especially for children. Often made with {豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく} (ground pork) or a mix of pork and chicken. The sweet-and-sour version ({甘酢|あまず}あんかけ) is one of the most common preparations.

COUNTER: {個|こ}
